description: Read a CFR section. Use this when the user asks what a specific US federal regulation says, including an FDA, OSHA, EPA, SEC, FTC or FAA section of the eCFR, for example "what does 21 CFR 11.10 say?", "read 29 CFR 1910.134" or "show me 17 CFR 240.10b-5". Pass the CFR title number and the section number. Returns the current text, heading, statutory authority and amendment history of the section, the date the eCFR is up to date as of and a link to it. A very long section is cut at a paragraph and flagged with nextOffset; call again with that offset to read on. This is general information, not legal advice. Do not use it to find a regulation by topic (use search_cfr), for statutes, state law or court decisions, or to decide whether someone complies.

offset.description: Where to start reading, in characters. Leave out to read from the start; to read on in a section that was cut, pass the nextOffset of the last answer.

section.description: Section number as written in the citation, without the section sign: "11.10", "240.10b-5" or "1910.134".

title.description: CFR title number, 1 to 50: for example 21 is Food and Drugs, 29 Labor, 17 Securities, 40 Environment, 14 Aeronautics.

name: get_cfr_section
title: Read a CFR section
